title: biscutella didyma var. columnae
intro: Biscutella didyma var. columnae, commonly known as Alpine Penny-cress, is a plant species in the family Brassicaceae. It is a perennial herb with various health benefits, including its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, which may help in protecting against cell damage, reducing inflammation, and preventing infections. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Penny-cress include its use in traditional medicine for treating various conditions, such as respiratory issues, skin problems, and gastrointestinal disorders, due to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of Alpine Penny-cress include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
